headline: Clinton order makes another change to the rules for an advisory committee on the public duties of digital TV broadcasters.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13038 again. That earlier order set up an advisory committee to study what public interest duties TV broadcasters should have as they move to digital signals. The title does not say what was changed, so the specific details are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Advisory Committee on Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters
who_it_affects.how: The rules for their committee are changed in some way not described in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 22, 1997; the exact effective date is not stated in the available information.
